accepted.sentence: Yellow-fleshed forms contain carotenoid pigments, including beta-carotene, that contribute to the pulp’s golden coloration.
Volatile esters in the fresh flesh, including ethyl butanoate, contribute to its sweet, fruity aroma.
Leaf margins may bear sharply pointed spines, although some cultivated forms have nearly smooth edges.
Each individual flower has three petals and three sepals, giving its floral structure a repeated three-part organization.
Small bracts beneath individual flowers persist as scale-like units across the mature fruit’s exterior.
A waxy cuticle covers the leaf blades and helps limit water loss from their exposed surfaces.
Individual flowers are bisexual, containing both male and female reproductive organs within each blossom.
Unfiltered juice is naturally cloudy because tiny suspended particles of flesh remain dispersed in the liquid.
